walkthroughs.body_html:
Metals — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Metals brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Metals.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Iron is extracted in a blast furnace using:
options: electrolysis
carbon reduction
acid reaction
distillation

mcqs.q: Why is aluminium more expensive to extract than iron?
options: aluminium is rarer
electrolysis uses lots of electricity
aluminium ore is heavy
aluminium is dense

mcqs.q: When water boils, what is broken?
options: The covalent bonds between hydrogen and oxygen atoms are broken when water boils.
ΔH becomes zero because the change cancels out.
Water molecules split into hydrogen and oxygen gas when they boil.
Intermolecular forces (hydrogen bonds) between water molecules are broken — the O-H covalent bonds stay intact.

mcqs.q: When you reverse a reaction in a Hess cycle, what happens to ΔH?
options: Water molecules split into hydrogen and oxygen gas when they boil.
Its sign reverses — if the forward reaction is +100 kJ/mol, the reverse is -100 kJ/mol.
ΔH becomes zero because the change cancels out.
ΔH stays the same because it's the same reaction.

mcqs.q: At room temperature and pressure, what volume does 1 mole of any gas occupy?
options: Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
Heavier gases occupy a smaller volume per mole because their particles are denser.
ΔH becomes zero because the change cancels out.
Approximately 24 dm^3 (24,000 cm^3), regardless of the identity of the gas.

sequence.def: Iron ore, coke and limestone enter the furnace
Blown in near the bottom of the furnace
C + O2 → CO2 releases heat, raising the temperature
CO2 reacts with more hot coke: CO2 + C → 2CO
Dense liquid iron sinks and is run off at the base
